# tools/test/code_hash_a64_corpus.txt: the arm64 code hash twins' corpus (port/platform/code_hash.c,
# tools/code_hash_a64.py). Real functions of v0.11.15 (_a) and v0.11.16-rc8 (_b) as their
# released libmain.so holds them (one game source, two links), the erratum 843419 stubs their
# branches lead to, and variants. Lines: "fn NAME ADDR" then its words ("w"), its stubs
# ("stub ADDR WORD0 WORD1", the code range a site's stub is read from); "from NAME BASE ADDR"
# a copy of BASE at ADDR with words set ("set K WORD") and its stubs replaced when "stubs"
# follows; "hash R1 R2 R3" its hashes under rules 1, 2 and 3 (made by tools/code_hash_a64.py,
# which --selftest checks again; code_hash_corpus_test checks the C twin); "same A B R" and
# "differ A B R" what rules R must say of two of them; "writes WORD R3 R2" the general registers
# an instruction writes as rules 3 and as rules 1 and 2 decode it (rules 3's by hand from the
# A64 encoding tables). Hex, no 0x.
